title: Owner Auto Policy Rate Manual — Acquisition Expense Withheld on Early Cancellation for Nonpayment
content:
**Rule.** On a cancellation of an Owner Auto Policy term for nonpayment, acquisition expense is withheld from the return premium. It is withheld once on a term, at its first cancellation: the term carries no earlier return premium entry for a cancellation for nonpayment or a cancellation at the insured's request. The amount turns on how far into the term the cancellation falls. That is counted in calendar days from the term effective date to the cancellation effective date, with the effective date counted and the cancellation effective date not counted.

| Term | Days into the term at cancellation | Acquisition expense withheld |
|---|---|---|
| New-business term (term number 1), first cancellation | fewer than 90 | 40.00 |
| New-business term (term number 1), first cancellation | at least 90 and fewer than 150 | 20.00 |
| New-business term, first cancellation | 150 or more | nothing |
| Renewal term (term number 2 or higher) | any | nothing |
| Any term with an earlier cancellation return entry | any | nothing |

The amount withheld is subtracted from the pro rata unearned premium. The return premium is never below 0.00.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**
- Cancelled on day 89 of a new-business term: 40.00 is withheld. On day 90: 20.00.
- Cancelled on day 149: 20.00 is withheld. On day 150: nothing.
- A new-business term cancelled for nonpayment, reinstated and later cancelled again has nothing withheld at the second cancellation, because it carries the earlier cancellation's return entry.
